rows.grounds: locative indicating the circumstance of disruption
instrumental referring to the fierce mantra/form

items.question: What recitation is prescribed when the lamp of well-being is interrupted?
premises: The lamp of well-being may undergo interruption.
The fierce mantra is the prescribed instrument in this circumstance.
A specific count of recitation is enjoined.
items.inference: Upon interruption of the lamp of well-being, one should chant one hundred repetitions with the fierce mantra.
uncertainties: Whether saukhyadīpa refers to a literal lamp or a metaphorical state is not explicit.
items.plain_english: If the lamp of well-being is interrupted, one should chant one hundred repetitions with the fierce mantra.
